security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU raises a software check exception (tval=4) for a tag mismatch on a regular load/store or checktag instruction but does NOT populate stval2/htval2/mtval3 with the virtual address of the faulting load/store, OR in asynchronous mode defers a store tag-mismatch exception past a trap-entry or trap-return boundary, OR reports multiple pending async tag mismatches out of program order.
security_spec.summary: Spec mandates stval2/htval2/mtval3 capture the faulting VA on tag-mismatch software check exceptions; QEMU failure to write these CSRs leaks stale register content to the guest and breaks the kernel's ability to identify the faulting access. Async mode adds ordering and trap-boundary resolution requirements that, if violated, can inject spurious exceptions into higher-privilege trap handlers.
